incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: p99 decode latency breach in prod-us-east-1 for model text-decode-v1 (streaming routes). Current p99 ~ 3.6s (SLO 1.5s). Affected clusters: inference-prod-eu/worker group and inference-prod-us-east-1/gpupool-03. Severity: S2. Escalation to eng-oncall.
Maya: on call — looking at dashboards now. any recent deploys?
Arjun: I see a TRT/FlashAttention kernel rollout that finished ~14:12 UTC (about 4m ago). Rollout tag: trt8-flashattn-upgrade-2026-03-14. It replaced compile kernel set with new conv kernels and changed compile flags: -DRASTERIZE=1, -O3, ENABLE_FLASH_ATTN=1.
Priya: confirmed p95 trending up as well. p95 ~ 820ms -> 1.2s since the rollout. Streaming stalls (clients see stalled event chunks) correlate with p99 spikes.
Seth: checking pod logs for decode worker in us-east-1/gpupool-03. grabbing tail: 
```
[14:15:03] decode_worker: batch=6 seq_len=2048 model=text-decode-v1 kernel=trt_conv_v2 compile_id=trt8-2026-03-14
[14:15:03] WARN kv_cache: page_faults=12 tenant=acct-42 route=/generate
[14:15:04] ERROR runtime: tail stall detected, stall_ms=1200 token_idx=178
[14:15:04] WARN trt: kernel_launch_slow: avg_ms=18.4 (expected 2-4ms)
```
Maya: kv cache page_faults + kernel_launch_slow looks like paging + a bad kernel combo. Are we seeing GPU memory pressure?
Arjun: GPU memory at sample time ~98% for that pod, but overall cluster free GPU mem is fine — the new kernel increases temporary workspace requirements for long seqs. Also noticed that the kernel selection logic changed to prefer trt_conv_v2 for >1k seqs.
Lina: CS reporting a small set of customers with streaming stalls and partial outputs (customers: research-proto, interactive-qna). They're on dedicated instances in us-east-1.
Priya: mitigation options: 1) revert rollout (slow, affects many models), 2) force fallback to aten/legacy kernels for text-decode-v1, 3) patch kernel selector to avoid trt_conv_v2 for seq_len>1024, 4) increase VM swap (bad idea). Recommend option 2 as fastest.
Seth: I can toggle runtime fallback flag per model. command: 
```bash
redwoodctl runtime set-flag --cluster inference-prod-us-east-1 \
  --model text-decode-v1 --flag FORCE_KERNEL=aten_fallback --reason "temp mitigation trt8-flashattn tail latency"
```
Maya: do it. push now and watch.
Seth: executing...
deploy-bot: Triggered runtime flag change: id=chg-92731 status=started by Seth
Seth: done, change applied to routing control plane. propagating to 8 pods.
Priya: telemetry shows p99 dropping already — new reading p99 ~ 1.1s (~70% reduction). streaming stalls count down from 36 -> 4 in last 90s. :thumbsup:
Arjun: interesting note — the compilepath changed how kernel workspace sizes are computed, so for long sequences the temp workspace exceeded threshold and TRTex fell back implicitly causing long tail when fallback happened mid-request. Forcing aten avoids that path.
Maya: can we patch the kernel selector so we don't need a full rollback? Arjun / Seth can you take an ownerable change to runtime selector and roll a targeted fix?
Arjun: yes — plan: revert selector preference for trt_conv_v2 for seq_len > 1024, add safety check on workspace_estimate < 0.8 * free_gpu_mem, and add telemetry for kernel_workspace_estimate. I'll open a PR and target a hotfix release.
Seth: I'll follow with a canary rollout to 2 pods in us-east-1, then 10, then 100%.
Lina: CS ping — tell affected customers we're mitigating and latency is improving, will follow up when hotfix is live. I'm sending a short note now.
Maya: summarize customer impact: 6 dedicated customers affected, median degraded sessions ~ 30s longer, a few streaming sessions experienced partial outputs ~ 10%. No data loss.
Priya: action items captured: 
- Seth: verify rollback flag persists across restarts and document temporary flag change chg-92731.
- Arjun: open runtime PR for selector + workspace safety check, target hotfix in 60m.
- Maya: notify on-call handoff if not resolved by next shift.
- Lina: CS follow-up to affected customers with post-mitigation summary.
Seth: flag persisted, added to runtime flags store, change id=chg-92731 marked completed.
Arjun: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/r/runtime/+/PR-1029 (hotfix branch trt8-kernelfallback). includes tests and additional telemetry hooks.
Maya: scheduling canary now. Seth proceed with canary.
Seth: canary started — patch applied to 2 pods. monitoring windows open.
Priya: metrics look stable on canary. p99 across canary pods ~ 0.9s, cpu/gpu stable.
Maya: rolling to 25% then 100% over next 20m if no regressions.
deploy-bot: rollout trt8-kernelfallback v1.0: 25% -> started.
Lina: sent customer note: "We identified a kernel selection regression tied to a recent runtime kernel rollout causing elevated tail latency for long-sequence streaming. We applied a temporary kernel fallback mitigant; we expect improved latency now and will follow up when a permanent fix is live."
Maya: quick postmortem notes in thread for handoff: root cause = kernel selector preference + new TRT kernel increased workspace needs causing mid-request implicit fallback and long tail stalls. Primary impact = p99 spike for streaming decode, 6 customers affected, no data loss. Mitigation = forced aten fallback + runtime selector hotfix rollout.
Priya: handoff to next oncall (Arjun primary, Seth secondary) at 15:00 UTC. If anything resurfaces reopen this thread.
Maya: thanks team. leaving oncall — handing to Arjun. :wave:
